Tom Brady: Was selected with the 199th pick of the NFL draft.
Won championships with New England and Tampa Bay.
Finished his career with seven Super Bowl victories.
Joe Montana: Played college football at Notre Dame.
Finished his NFL career in Kansas City.
Won three Super Bowl MVP awards.
Wore number 16 while winning four championships with San Francisco.
Patrick Mahomes: His father played Major League Baseball.
Played college football at Texas Tech.
Was selected tenth overall in the 2017 NFL draft.

The Beatles: Their recording career included sessions at Abbey Road Studios.
The classic lineup included John, Paul, George and Ringo.
Queen: The group formed in London in 1970.
Their guitarist earned a doctorate in astrophysics.
They performed at Wembley Stadium during Live Aid in 1985.
Freddie Mercury was their original lead vocalist.
Led Zeppelin: The group formed in London in 1968.
Their original lineup consisted of four musicians.
Robert Plant was their lead vocalist.

In-N-Out: Harry and Esther Snyder started the business.
Its first location opened in Baldwin Park, California.
Animal Style and Double-Double are signature menu terms.
Five Guys: Its first restaurant opened in Arlington, Virginia.
Complimentary peanuts are a familiar feature of its restaurants.
Its fries are cooked in peanut oil and served in paper bags.
Shake Shack: The business began as a food cart in 2001.
Restaurateur Danny Meyer was behind its creation.
Its first permanent location opened in Madison Square Park.
Its signature beef patties are served on potato buns.

Batman: First appeared in comic books in 1939.
His fictional hometown is Gotham City.
His secret identity is Bruce Wayne.
Spider-Man: Made his comic book debut in 1962.
Stan Lee and Steve Ditko created the original character.
His abilities include climbing walls and sensing danger.
The original character's secret identity is Peter Parker.
Superman: Made his comic book debut in 1938.
Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster created the character.
His fictional home planet is Krypton.
Works as a reporter under the name Clark Kent.

Star Wars: The original film was released in 1977.
The Millennium Falcon is a spacecraft in its fictional universe.
Jedi knights use weapons called lightsabers.
The Lord of the Rings: Its main film trilogy was released from 2001 through 2003.
Much of the trilogy was filmed in New Zealand.
Peter Jackson directed all three installments.
Frodo Baggins travels to Mount Doom.
Harry Potter: The original film series contains eight installments.
The first installment was released in 2001.
Daniel Radcliffe plays the central character.
Much of the story takes place at Hogwarts School.

Vanilla: Its primary flavoring comes from a flowering plant.
The flavoring plant belongs to the orchid family.
The harvested seed pods undergo a curing process.
Natural versions can contain tiny black specks from the seed pods.
Chocolate: Its primary flavoring comes from the seeds of a tropical tree.
The flavoring ingredients can include cocoa solids.
Its characteristic color is usually brown.
It gets its signature flavor from cacao beans.
Cookies and Cream: The flavor combines a frozen dessert with a baked confection.
It commonly contains dark pieces scattered throughout a pale base.
The added pieces are typically made from cocoa-flavored wafers.
Crushed Oreo-style sandwich biscuits are its defining ingredient.

Lionel Messi: Won an Olympic gold medal in 2008.
Spent the majority of his European club career at Barcelona.
Captained Argentina to victory at the 2022 FIFA World Cup.
Cristiano Ronaldo: Was born on the Portuguese island of Madeira.
Began his senior club career at Sporting CP.
Played for Manchester United, Real Madrid and Juventus.
His famous number-seven branding is abbreviated CR7.
Pelé: Finished his club career with the New York Cosmos.
Won the FIFA World Cup in 1958, 1962 and 1970.

Coca-Cola: Its original formula dates to the nineteenth century.
A pharmacist named John Pemberton created it.
It was first served at a pharmacy in Atlanta.
Its signature branding features white cursive lettering on red.
Dr Pepper: Its marketing highlights a blend of 23 flavors.
Sprite: The beverage is transparent rather than dark brown.
Its standard formula contains no caffeine.
Lemon and lime are its signature flavors.

PlayStation 2: Its original model was released in 2000.
It could also function as a DVD player.
Its slimmer redesigned model arrived in 2004.
Sony shipped it with the DualShock 2 controller.
Nintendo Switch: The original model launched in March 2017.
It supports both handheld and television gameplay.
An OLED model was introduced in 2021.
Its original controllers are called Joy-Con.
Xbox 360: It used an optional motion-sensing accessory called Kinect.
Its early hardware became associated with a red ring error.
Microsoft released it between its original console and 2013 successor.

Jim Carrey: Appeared on the sketch comedy series In Living Color.
Played the lead character in The Truman Show.
Portrayed the eccentric pet detective Ace Ventura.
Robin Williams: Won an Academy Award for Good Hunting, directed by Gus Van Sant.
Voiced the Genie in Disney's 1992 animated film Aladdin.
Adam Sandler: Joined Saturday Night Live in 1990 as a writer.
Played the title character in Billy Madison.
Portrayed an aspiring professional golfer in Happy Gilmore.

Monopoly: Parker Brothers began publishing the game in 1935.
Its origins trace back to a game designed by Elizabeth Magie.
Players can collect rent from their opponents.
Passing the GO space earns $200 in the classic edition.
Chess: Its historical origins are associated with an ancient Indian game.
The standard playing board has 64 squares.
Victory occurs when the opposing king is checkmated.
Risk: It was originally developed by a French filmmaker.
The original French version appeared in 1957.
Its classic board divides the world into 42 territories.
Players deploy armies and roll dice to conquer territories.

The Lion King: The original animated film was released in 1994.
Hans Zimmer composed its original score.
Its story unfolds in the African savanna.
Simba, Timon and Pumbaa are central characters.
Aladdin: The original animated film premiered in 1992.
Alan Menken composed its original score.
Much of the story takes place in the fictional city of Agrabah.
A magical lamp contains a Genie voiced by Robin Williams.
Beauty and the Beast: The original animated film was released in 1991.
It received an Academy Award nomination for Best Picture.
Its castle contains enchanted household objects that can speak.
A young woman named Belle encounters a cursed prince.
